key_facts: Gabriel Bortoleto, driver of car 5 for Audi Revolut F1 Team, moved his car under braking (changed direction while slowing down) approaching Turn 5 in the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.
This breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code caused him to impact car 43, which was forced to leave the track.
The Stewards issued a Warning to Bortoleto, which is equivalent to a black/white flag (a warning for unsportsmanlike or dangerous driving).
plain_explanation: Gabriel Bortoleto (car 5, Audi Revolut F1 Team) received a Warning from the Stewards during the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix on 13 September 2026. He moved his car under braking when approaching Turn 5, which hit car 43 and forced it off the track. The rules do not allow drivers to change direction while braking, because it creates danger. The Stewards gave a Warning instead of the baseline penalty, which is a black/white flag.
